Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting victim's files in the background while distracting victims with ESET AV Remover installation
Spam campaign delivering email attachments containing Dharma dropper binary packed as password-protected self-extracting archive named Defender.exe
Use of password-protected archive with password listed in spam email to entice victims to open and execute malware
Dropping old ESET AV Remover installer (Defender_nt32_enu.exe) and taskhost.exe Dharma binary to startup folder to start encryption
Using Enigma1crypt@aol.com email address for ransomware developer contact
Bundling legitimate ESET AV Remover software signed with valid digital signature to distract victims
Attack Vector: Spam email campaign with password-protected self-extracting archive attachment
